expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Requests a debugger break when script debugging is enabled. Reports a recoverable assertion failure and returns the condition. Reports a recoverable assertion failure with a message and returns the condition. @param Condition Expression that must remain true. @param Message Diagnostic text emitted on failure. Reports every recoverable assertion failure and returns the condition. Reports every recoverable assertion failure with a message and returns the condition. @param Condition Expression that must remain true. @param Message Diagnostic text emitted on every failure. Raises an AngelScript exception. @param Message Exception text exposed to script error handling.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Observe receiver, object, collection, callback, diagnostic, or lifecycle state after each void call. Exercise both true and false outcomes unless the API contract documents a single reachable result.
inputs: Nominal values for every listed parameter, one default or empty state, and one behavior-specific boundary derived from the registration notes.
testScope: void DebugBreak(); | bool ensure(bool Condition); | bool ensure(bool Condition, const FString& Message); | bool ensureAlways(bool Condition); | bool ensureAlways(bool Condition, const FString& Message); | void throw(const FString& Message);
